parameters.formDescription: Select languages, strategies, stage ablations, and a provider for each LLM role. Then configure the selected model and n8n credential in the matching standard AI Model node on the canvas.

values.html:
LLM roles

Models are selected with the built-in selector of the matching OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Gemini Chat Model node. This form selects only which configured provider node each role uses.

Pipeline stages / ablation

Every disableable component has an explicit Enabled or Disabled value.

values.formSubmittedText: LLM4MTL pipeline accepted. Follow the execution in n8n.
